# Daniel Rakotomalala {.hero-name .unnumbered .unlisted}

::: {.hero-body}
[Data scientist and project lead, DEPP]{.hero-role}

I'm Daniel, a data scientist and project lead at DEPP, the statistical directorate of the French Ministry of Education, where I am the project lead for IDEE, a partnership with J-PAL Europe that gives researchers access to the ministry's administrative data. I did a PhD in economics, which is where my interest in causal inference comes from. Most of my code is R, and I write packages that make empirical work easier to check and to reproduce.
